[LSER.6.10.1] A *series cursor* is a compile-time designator
that identifies which observation on which slot, under which
label, to access. It has up to three components:

1. **Binding** — always present (`t`, `j`, `l`, …)
2. **Slot designator** — present when cross-slot
   disambiguation is needed
3. **Label** — present when the target observation line was
   declared `as <label>`
